pages.name: Scandinavian Defense: Lasker Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed g4 onto the bishop's square and used a g-file that stays closed after Qxf3; plan 2 said ...Bxf3 damages White's structure. Rewrote plans 1 and 2; British spelling.

pages.name: Scandinavian Defense: Mieses-Kotroc Variation
pages.notes: Plan 2 wrote the bishop's squares ambiguously (Bf5/g4). Reworded plan 2; British spelling.

pages.name: Scandinavian Defense: Portuguese Gambit, Elbow Variation
pages.notes: Plan 4 pushed h3 and g4 into the g4-bishop and read e5 as a move: rewrote plan 4 (accepted). Plans 1 and 3 build on 5.dxc6 Nxc6, but 5.dxc6 leaves the d1-queen to ...Bxd1 and sources give 5.Be2 or 5.f3 as White's usual replies; the reviewer rejected a reworded plan 3 twice, so plans 1 and 3 keep their old text (British spelling only) until the main line is settled.

pages.name: Scandinavian Defense: Portuguese Gambit, Jadoul Variation
pages.notes: Plan 3 developed an 'f1-knight' and controlled d5 where White's own pawn stands; plan 2 called ...a6 a pawn break. Rewrote plans 2 and 3; British spelling.

pages.name: Scandinavian Defense: Portuguese Gambit, Melbourne Shuffle Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 played Bg2 with White's light-squared bishop on b5. Rewrote plan 1; British spelling.

pages.name: Scandinavian Defense: Portuguese Variation, Portuguese Gambit
pages.notes: Plan 2 played Bg2 with White's light-squared bishop on b5; plan 4 called the f3-pawn a hook for White. Rewrote plans 2 and 4; British spelling.

pages.name: Scandinavian Defense: Richter Variation
pages.notes: Plan 3 played ...Nxc4 with no pawn on c4 and said ...Nb6 supports ...c5. Rewrote plans 2 and 3; British spelling.

pages.name: Scandinavian Defense: Schiller-Pytel Variation, Modern Variation
pages.notes: Plan 4 sent the queen to c7 or a6, neither reachable from b4; plan 3 used a kingside majority White doesn't have and ignored the attack on c4 and b2. Rewrote plans 3 and 4 (reviewer: plan 3 rejected once, revised to Bb3 first, re-accepted).

pages.name: Scandinavian: 2...Nf6 3.Bb5+
pages.notes: Plan 1 wrote castling as 0-0. Reworded plan 1.

pages.name: Scandinavian: 2...Nf6 3.Bb5+ Bd7 4.Bc4 Bg4
pages.notes: Plan 1 named White's f3 in Black's plan; plan 2 gave White a bishop pair it doesn't have and missed the extra d5-pawn. Rewrote plans 1 and 2 (reviewer: plan 2 rejected once for c4 with the bishop there, revised, re-accepted).
